$comment: Conformance profile per atlas-chai-crosswalk.md Priority 4 / atlas-conformance-profiles.md. Cumulative: allOf-references procurement-ready.json so every procurement-ready constraint still applies, then adds its own increment (each nested `required` is restated down to the leaf per the note's "required does not cascade" trap; this branch defines no new properties). DEFERRED pending fields that do not yet exist in the base schema (per the note's "profiles cannot ship first" and the HTI-1/Annex IV convergent-gap list): structured training-data characterization; a declared bias-mitigation approach; at least one subgroup-disaggregated performance record; at least one performance record with Test type "External"; a Maintenance object (validity/fairness monitoring, update process); a Factors declaration; a foundation-model flag; human-oversight measures; security posture; third-party/pre-trained-component disclosure. These will be added to this profile once the corresponding base-schema fields exist.
